# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 86 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 86

**1** Jesus said: "The foxes have their dens and the birds have their nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head and rest."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Direct parallel to Matthew 8:20 / Luke 9:58 (Q saying)
- **ⲡϣⲏⲣⲉ ⲙⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ** / *pshēre mprōme*: "the Son of Man" — literally "the son of the human being"; the ambiguous self-designation
- Thomas version is very close to Q; "rest" (*anapausis*) is added — the Thomas keyword for the ultimate resting place
- The addition of "and rest" links the Son of Man saying to the Thomas theme of *anapausis* (Sayings 50, 60, 90)
- The Son of Man lacks *anapausis* — placing him in the category of the seeker who has not yet found rest
